home.strapline: Learn cyber security from scratch for £{price} a month

tracks.title: Every course, one subscription
tracks.intro: Each course follows the vendor's published exam blueprint and is mentored by someone who has sat the exam. Applications are reviewed individually — pick the course that matches where you are now, not where you would like to be.
tracks.notSureBody: Tell us where you are and what you are aiming at. We will point you at the right one — including if that means waiting.
tracks.refundNote: Not accepted? Your subscription is cancelled and refunded in full, automatically.

contact.title: Talk to us

success.title: Application received
success.intro: Thank you. We read every application ourselves and will reply within {responseTime}.
success.quoteIt: Quote this if you contact us about your application.
success.saveNow: Save this now — it is shown once and nowhere else.
success.statusBody: It is the only way to check your application without contacting us, and we cannot recover it for you, only issue a new one.
success.noLinkTitle: We could not create your status link.
success.noLinkBody: Your application is safely recorded — this only affects the self-service page. Email {email} with your reference and we will send you one.
success.next1: We read your application in full — a person, not a filter.
success.next2: We reply within {responseTime} with a decision and written feedback, whichever way it goes.
success.next3: If we offer you a place, that email explains exactly how to start.
success.emailSentBody: We have sent a confirmation with your reference and the status link above. If it has not arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder — and if it is not there either, email {email} with your reference.
success.noEmailBody: We are not sending confirmation emails yet, so this page is your only record — that is why the link above matters. If you lose it, email {email} with your reference.

status.noPaymentNeeded: No payment is required at this stage.
status.beingRead: A person is reading it. We reply within {responseTime}.
status.decisionMade: A decision has been made — see below.
status.willHear: You will hear from us by email.
status.feedbackPending: Written feedback appears here once we have made a decision — you get it either way, not only if you are accepted.
status.needSomethingBody: To ask about your application or to withdraw it, email {email} quoting {reference}. This link is private to you — treat it like a password.
